description: This file defines controller functions for handling execution-related API endpoints, including retrieving, updating, and deleting executions in a server-side application.

methods.name: getExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches an execution by its ID, considering the active workspace ID from the user context.

methods.name: getPublicExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches a public execution by its ID without workspace restrictions.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an execution with data from the request body, considering the workspace context.

methods.name: getAllExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of executions filtered by various query parameters such as ID, flow, session, state, date range, and pagination.

methods.name: deleteExecutions
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple executions based on URL parameter or request body input.
